residents

  • subglow/

  • VERSION/

    For more than 10 years, VERSION has been a crucial OHM fixture. Orson and DJ Hops have not only created a hub for futuristic, bass-heavy club music – they have also shaped OHM’s musical identity and sound.

    Orson is a visual artist, DJ, and producer who runs the VERSION record label. Being part of London’s original dubstep scene – and one of its foremost documentarians – Orson’s sonic vision remains at the cutting-edge. DJ Hops a.k.a. Gloveman, sharp-shooter selecta for more than two decades, is considered an expert on sound system culture, well-known from the Hard Wax counter back in the days.

    With a sound palette that spans from dub, house, and jungle to current club bangers, Orson and Hops bring it all together under one roof, in love, peace, and ecstasy.

  • Sneaker Social Club/

    Sneaker always had it’s roots in the UK underground, Rave, Jungle, UKG, Grime, Dubstep – so the labels output is representative of that, it is always done with a view to look forward with it though. Avoiding pastiche tropes.
    This year marks 14 yrs of the label! next year we will run some big 15 yr anniversary parties across the globe.

  • Garage Girls/

    Garage Girls is a female curated party series and radio event. Founded by The Honey Tapes and DJ NORTHERN. Focused on empowering and promoting female artists, highlighting and sharing a passion for Garage Music.

  • Life Classics/

  • Awkwardly Social/

    Awkwardly Social is a Berlin-based club night, record label, and collective dedicated to an eclectic range of music, with a strong focus on community.

  • Kookoo/

    energy, frequency, and vibration…
    … are KOOKOO’s raw materials. The bimonthly event, hosted by Mieko Suzuki and Arno Raffeiner aka Ara, focuses on electronic music, sonic challenges, and their connections to visual and performance art. KOOKOO is based on a constant exchange between artists of various disciplines who initiate a dialogue with each other and the audience, making space for awareness and change.

  • Merger/

    Merger is rooted in the sound universe of dub, dissolving genre boundaries. Intimate moments on the dance floor and swaying dancers are at the heart of the series.

  • Kontinuum/

    Information Exchange is the foundation of Kontinuum. Facilitated through careful curation, Kontinuum draws equal inspiration from the old guard and the new generation, recognising the authentic talent and energy that exists between both. The core message is love, expressed through music and only truly understood when experienced firsthand.

  • La Noche/

    An ongoing homage to the trio’s shared obsession for the warm nostalgia and groove of queer nightlife. This single thread carries through the event series’ intentionality with sound, aesthetics and community values – always in the name of joy and reinstating a sense of intimacy within Berlin’s vast club scene.

    Byron first teamed up with S-candalo as residents for his Radiant Love party series, with the duo’s classicly camp and euphoric sound levelling his signature prog, trance and hard-house style. La Noche marks a true collaboration of the three’s distinct vibes, creating a space that actualises the elative state their sets collectively induce.

  • Astral Industries/

    Astral Industries is a London-based purveyor of cosmic music, spanning from ambient to techno and beyond into the outer realms, rooted in OHM’s boundless ethos.

Privacy Policy

This website is owned and operated by OHM Berlin. We prioritize your privacy and have designed this website to operate without the collection of personal data.

1. No Data Collection
We do not collect, store, or process any personal information (such as your name, email address, or phone number) through this website. There are no registration forms, comment sections, or newsletters.

2. Server Logs & Technical Data
To ensure website security and functionality, our hosting provider may automatically process technical data, such as your IP address, browser type, and time of access. This data is processed for the legitimate interest of maintaining site stability and is typically deleted automatically by the server.

3. Cookies
This website does not use non-essential tracking cookies or marketing scripts. We only use strictly necessary technical cookies if required for the basic operation of the WordPress platform.

4. Your Rights
Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, or erase any data we might hold about you. Because we do not collect personal data, we generally hold no information to provide or delete. However, you may contact us for any privacy-related inquiries.

5. Third-Party Links
Our site may contain links to other websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those external sites.

    T35: OHM Recovery

    Barbara Preisinger
    Daniel Bell
    Fumiya Tanaka
    On March 13, 1991 Tresor opened its doors and helped define a new language for underground music and collective experience. Thirty-five years later, the opening chapter of this anniversary year unfolds as a 30+ hour continuous event, spanning across Tresor, Globus, OHM and Aurora Bar. *There will be no presale tickets available for OHM's day event. ** Access to OHM is only valid between 11-20h, it is not in combination with Saturday night's event. OHM Tickets can only be purchased in combination with a Tresor pass. SCHEDULE Friday, March 13: TRESOR / GLOBUS: 22:00 - 12:00 Adriana Lopez, Blake Baxter, DJ Bone, DJ T-1000 aka Alan Oldham, Function LIVE, Madalba b2b Handmade, Mareena b2b Kerrie, Scott Grooves Saturday, March 14: OHM: 11:00 - 20:00 Barbara Preisinger, Daniel Bell, Fumiya Tanaka TRESOR / GLOBUS: 19:00 - 13:00 Chloe Lula, Helena Hauff b2b IMOGEN, James Ruskin b2b Lee Gamble, Nicole, Moritz von Oswald, Sarah Sommers LIVE, Scott Grooves, Tanith, UFO95 LIVE, Vio PRG, .VRIL LIVE Passes are available via ra.co
